# Popup and compose session values use a native-object bucket for their lifetime

getSessionData creates _ext when a native popup or compose object lacks it, then creates extensionSession and the calling extension widget-ID bucket. Set, get and remove all use that getter, so a read can initialize empty storage. The mail-tab monitor separately persists/restores extensionSession. Popup and compose support is lifetime storage; this change does not restore those windows on restart. The test directly checks missing, set, updated and removed values for four tab roles, but does not test restart or multiple-extension isolation.

Scope: Extensions sessions tab-data ownership.
